contract.hardware: Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 / Radeon 890M / 32GiB / Windows11 build26300
contract.input_class: Three generated independent original H264 3840x2160 60/1 sources with repeated source offsets
contract.cache_state: Fresh frozen application each trial; repeated offsets; unmanaged OS cache
contract.observer: Native counter delta / wall time including end-observation tail; actual Windows DPI175%, physical356x200, no Playwright focus emulation, foreground/unobscured owned QA window continuously verified; not physical scanout

collection: Ten alternating baseline/candidate pairs, no Playwright default overrides; fresh host per case, unmanaged OS cache. No covered, artificial-focus or failed uncontrolled case is replaced or mixed into this cohort.

throughput_windows.method: Native status-counter deltas over >=window, <=window+.5 s; not physical scanout.
Native status-counter deltas over >=window, <=window+.5 s; not physical scanout.

window_condition.scope: Physical center hit-test and window state, not physical scanout. Owned QA topmost/cover windows only; no global Windows settings.

physical_alignment.scope: Default browser zoom; physical HWND/client coordinates, independent of the reported emulated DPR.

active_throughput_windows.method: Native status-counter deltas over >=window, <=window+.5 s; not physical scanout. Frame-zero preparation and terminal paused status excluded.

variant: Final compressed recovery history, full clock responses, actual Windows DPI with aligned physical356x200 surface; native C++/caches/encoder policy unchanged
historical_baseline_scope: Archived348 has the same356x200 GPU workload but legacy DPR1 emulation misplaced the child window. Final/current controls use actual Windows DPI and independently verified physical alignment; historical visual-placement equivalence is not claimed.
active_cadence_scope: Reciprocal of mean active Present interval; ancillary metric. Does not replace the protected wall-time FPS, erase skipped frames or establish physical scanout. End-observation tails remain in original scores.
variance_scope: Across-run FPS/mean interval variation; exact per-frame variance unavailable. Histogram percentiles are upper bounds, not physical scanout.
